test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

It was due to __treacherous__ leaders that he decided to leave the party.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Disloyal."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"treacherous"** means disloyal, deceitful or untrustworthy. ((व्यक्ति) विश्‍वासघाती और हानि पहुँचा सकने वाला; धोखेबाज़)

 
 
• **Example:** *He was weak, cowardly and **treacherous**__.*
 
 
 
• The word **"disloyal"** means not supporting your friends, family, country etc.; doing something that will harm them. ((मित्र, परिवार, देश आदि के प्रति) निष्‍ठाहीन, बेवफ़ा; बेवफ़ाई करने वाला)
 __
 
• **Example:** *It was **disloyal**__ to your friends to repeat their conversation with Prem.*
 
 
 
• *​*The synonym of **"treacherous"** is **"disloyal."**
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Devoted"** means loyal, dedicated or committed, but it is the opposite of the intended meaning in the sentence. (किसी से प्रेम करने वाला; किसी के प्रति पूर्णतया समर्पित)
 
• **"Transient"** means temporary or short-lived, which is not related to the context of the sentence. (कुछ अवधि तक जारी रहनेवाला; क्षणिक, क्षणभंगुर, अस्थायी)
 
• **"Ravenous"** means extremely hungry, which is not related to the context of the sentence. (बहुत भूखा; मरभुक्‍खा)

145:T728,
The correct answer is **"becoming."**
